source_type: public reference application, not production deployment
task: Improve this existing TodoMVC task-management application for everyday use at desktop 1440×900 and phone 390×844 with touch. Make tasks, completion state, navigation and available actions easier to understand and use. Preserve the existing branding, task data and all current add/edit/cancel/complete/filter/delete/clear-all-completed workflows. Keep long task text understandable. Do not add invented functionality, decorative dashboards, external assets or dependencies. The upstream Store is in-memory only: retain that semantics; persistence is outside scope. Preserve author and project credits. Deliver working code within this resource budget.
common_harness_time: included in wall deadline; recorded separately
tools: forbidden to executors, checked in JSONL; no delegation
workflow_limit: frozen skill supplied as text, independent implementation/review unavailable within this matched three-reply format
hard_gates: Preserve all upstream task workflows and credits; no lost text, important unavailable controls, page overflow or fabricated verification. Baseline limitations documented.
visual_gate: Two fresh independent blind reviewers both explicitly prefer with-skill, paired mean difference >=2/24 in six frozen dimensions. Hard pass required for both. Ties, failures, unequal replies and timeouts remain reported; no retry/tuning this project.
